jobs.occupation: Producer and a Director of Photography
jobs.description:
The film is set in 1470 and follows a scout trekking alone through nature. In a poetic and contemplative narrative about death, morality, spirituality, faith, and human nature, his encounter with a knight and the subsequent confrontation become a catalyst for the mental struggles he fights. 
So, apart from the fight scene, the focus really lies on atmosphere, emotion, and a strong visual narrative. It is a narrative poem. 
English: 
For an ambitious short film, I am looking for a producer and a Director of Photography to help bring this project to life. 
The film is set in 1470 and follows a scout traveling alone through the wilderness. In a poetic and contemplative narrative about death, morality, spirituality, faith, and human nature, his encounter with a knight and the confrontation that follows becomes a catalyst for the inner struggles he is battling. 
Beyond the fight scene, the film's primary focus is on atmosphere, emotion, and strong visual storytelling. It's a narrative poem.

We offer an incredibly fun experience on a unique set. 
We offer experience in whatever field you participate in. 
We offer an extremely strong project for your portfolio. 
Furthermore, we naturally reimburse all travel, catering, and expenses.

Planning, Recruitment & HR Coordinator 
Are you well-organised, communicative, and do you enjoy working with drivers, applicants and colleagues on a daily basis? For a transport company, we are looking for a Planning, Recruitment & HR Coordinator. 
This is a varied position combining transport planning, recruitment and HR responsibilities. What will you be doing?

Your responsibilities will include: - Supporting the daily transport planning; - Coordinating and supporting drivers; - Communicating with drivers about schedules, changes and any issues that may arise; - Responding quickly to changes or problems during the day; - Contacting new applicants by phone; - Conducting initial telephone interviews with candidates; - Scheduling and following up on job interviews; - Starting and monitoring the recruitment process; - Contributing ideas for the recruitment and selection of new drivers and employees; - Actively contributing to HR and personnel policies; - Keeping personnel files complete and up to date; - Checking whether required documents, information and certificates are complete and valid; - Identifying missing documents or documents that are about to expire; - Supporting other administrative and organisational tasks related to employees and planning.
